method: Ten agents each read one literal 89-idea corpus shard in full and classified every entry by the economic primitive a software miniature would embody today, who pays and how money enters; a separate agent catalogued real-world lawful mechanisms with current sources. Titles are copied from the literal corpus, not from model output.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Pay-per-verified-error: price defect, anomaly and leak discovery per independently confirmed finding (zero if none), fed by monitoring that makes previously hidden failures observable.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Near-zero buyer risk removes the main objection to a cold offer. Price tracks delivered value, and each confirmed finding is its own evidence artifact. It maps directly onto current agency revenue-leak and lead-path offers, and it converts naturally into a recurring monitoring subscription once errors keep turning up.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Warranty and insurance underwriting, where measured defect rates become priced risk; contingency procurement-recovery audits; AI release gates that price a model regression per confirmed failure.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Calibration ledger: every consequential prediction is timestamped and later reconciled against reality. This produces a portable track-record asset, and it lets budget, compute or attention flow to sources that are actually calibrated.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It makes forecast quality sellable and auditable, and it is the base for outcome pricing, value-of-information allocation and UberBond's internal prediction economy. It also builds a moat: a track record can only be built over time and cannot be faked after the fact.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Reputation-as-collateral for experts and freelancers, underwriting of outcome-priced contracts, and credit-style scoring of models and analysts.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Attested acceptance evidence with release-on-verification settlement: compile a fuzzy quality claim into measurable criteria, produce a signed, reproducible evidence pack, and release money when the attestation passes.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It turns trust between strangers into a reusable asset that can be verified. It supports a premium price for verified deliverables plus a disclosed per-transaction trust fee. It also fits directly into the AI Acceptance Evidence Tollbooth and AI Agent Release Gate offers.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Trade-finance letters of credit, royalty and licensing settlement, supply-chain provenance, and milestone-escrowed temporary organizations.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Independent-model disagreement triage: run materially different reasoners and send only the items they disagree on to humans. Price per item reviewed, or only on measured gain over a single-model baseline.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It replaces expensive human review at scale and keeps humans on exactly the contested items. Savings can be measured against a held-out, fully reviewed sample, which makes outcome pricing credible. Disagreement patterns also surface hidden assumptions.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Insurance claims adjudication, clinical coding and medical-record QA, legal discovery, content moderation, and data-labeling marketplaces.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Counterfactual baseline for incremental-outcome pricing: estimate what would have happened without the intervention (synthetic control, uplift), then charge on the measured increment or on a share of the savings.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Without a credible counterfactual, pay-for-results contracts, savings-share deals and renewal-grade ROI proof are not possible. With one, they work across the whole offer portfolio (Revenue Proof and Renewal Pack, optimization savings-share, staged commitments).
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Additionality in carbon credits, performance-based public procurement, synthetic-control arms in clinical trials, and marketing-attribution royalties.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Evidence-carrying claim attestation: sell a claim packaged with its evidence, provenance, assumptions, falsifiers, freshness date and an explicit UNKNOWN option, priced per claim or per pack and refundable when a reconstruction or replication test fails.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Each extra pack costs little to make, the buyer can check what they got, and buyers already pay for diligence, fact-checking and reproducibility. It reuses UberBond's evidence-pack and acceptance machinery and is the core of the AI Acceptance Evidence Tollbooth.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Insurance underwriting and procurement warranties: attested claims could lower premiums or trigger warranty payouts. Paired with a calibrated forecast ledger, they let claims themselves be priced like risk.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Capacity-routing spread: pool idle capacity of different kinds (machine shops, labs, instruments, solvers, compute), measure price-performance per job class, send each job to the winner, and take a disclosed fee or a share of savings.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It needs no owned assets, earns a take rate on both sides, and every routed job adds measurements that compound into a data moat. The same mechanism is already being proven in UberBond's model routing (OpenRouter/UberMind).
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Anything perishable or time-priced: energy flexibility (0123), freight backhaul, clinic appointment slots. Yield management applied to idle time turns the router into a timing-arbitrage engine.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Dependency-indexed change propagation: record which accounts, documents and plans depend on which upstream facts; when a fact changes, deliver the exact impact list and redlines to everything downstream.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Revenue recurs because the world keeps changing, and the buyer already feels the compliance and timing pain of being late. Once a customer's dependency index is built, switching away costs them that index.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Regulatory and platform-policy changes, API deprecations, supplier price changes, clinical guideline updates. Pairs with the Knowledge Packet (0146) so each alert carries its evidence and falsifiers.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Outcome-priced waste recovery: find value leaking from a client's flows (energy, cycle time, supplier quotes, disposal, tariffs, manual scheduling), fix it with low-cost changes, and charge a percentage of verified savings.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: The buyer pays only out of realized savings, which removes their risk and helps close sales; the baseline measurement already exists in their bills and logs. It matches UberBond's revenue-leak and payment-before-proof doctrine.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Cloud and SaaS spend, ad spend, payment-processing fees, claim denials. Combine with the Missing-Variable Detector (0171) to explain why leaks recur and to sell a monitoring renewal.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Trust-layer insertion: find exchanges that fail because trust, measurement, consent or scoped authority is missing; supply that layer (inspection report, acceptance escrow via a licensed provider, consent receipt, least-privilege grant); and take a fee on the transactions it unblocks.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It produces new markets rather than serving one, and every instance earns a take rate. It also captures fast-growing compliance demand from AI agents acting on people's behalf.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Agent-to-agent commerce: agents that transact for users need scoped, revocable authority, consent receipts and acceptance escrow. Combine with outcome pricing (0166) and attested claims (0146) to settle agent work automatically.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Prerequisite-triggered resurrection: record shelved, expired, lapsed or abandoned ideas with explicit blockers, then charge when a blocker measurably changes (cost curve, API release, material, compute).
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It runs on public data (lapsed and expired patents, defunded programs, release feeds) with near-zero marginal cost. It combines information and timing arbitrage, and it sells naturally as a recurring subscription with evidence-linked alerts.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: UberBond's Resurrection Engine and Economic Spores for dormant opportunities; event-driven capital triggers; Capability Genome alerts when a new model release removes a blocker on a rejected offer.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Application-cascade matching: expand a discovery or asset into a tree of first- and second-order applications, then match branches to licensees, sponsors or missing connectors for a fixed fee plus a success fee.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It turns idle supply (unlicensed patents, prize challenges, integration gaps) into transactions where the matchmaker can take a success fee or royalty. Revenue scales with the number of branches searched, not with labor.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Distribution OS partner and white-label matching; university tech-transfer royalties; connector marketplaces; bounty and prize markets.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Claim-vs-evidence verification as the scarce good once cognition is cheap: price receipts that prove a claimed capability or action really happened, and separate real signal from artifacts.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: As generation gets cheap, trust and measurement become the binding constraint. Verification sits on a shared bottleneck across every AI deployment, and buyers pay before they accept work.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: AI Acceptance Evidence Tollbooth and Agent Production Release Gate; escrow release triggered by verified receipts; underwriting inputs for AI-agent insurance.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Binding-constraint diagnosis with outcome pricing: find the current bottleneck or dead-end spend from the client's own logs, charge a share of the verified gain, then rotate to the next emergent constraint on a subscription.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Gain-share pricing removes the buyer's risk. Each fix exposes a new bottleneck, so a one-off sale becomes recurring revenue, and contingency cost recovery bills against money the client actually saved.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: SaaS and vendor spend recovery; revenue-leak monitoring; the 0190 model-routing savings share; forecasting the next scarcity in AI-agent operations.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Externalize scarce expert judgment into a replicable, evaluated artifact (rubric, agent or procedure base), collapse its marginal cost, and pay the source expert royalties weighted by downstream use.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It converts scarce, perishable human expertise into a rentable asset with software margins. The consented royalty aligns supply, and the 0204 downstream-use weighting creates a new attribution asset class.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Capability Genome atoms as rentable units; GCC bilingual QA and other scarce-skill offers; dependency-weighted open-source funding; continuity insurance for organizations losing key experts.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Verified-outcome contract: buyer states a measurable outcome against a pre-registered baseline, payment is held by a licensed escrow/payment provider, and released (or a bonus paid) only when bound evidence shows the outcome
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Turns any service into a lower-risk purchase for the buyer and lets a provider with real capability charge a premium; it also produces the proof that drives renewal. Software-only today using existing payment rails
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Combine with warranty/insurance underwriting (price the chance of failure), prediction markets (forecast outcome likelihood before bidding), or AI-agent bidders competing on causal plans

potentPrimitives.primitive: Causal contribution ledger with settlement: estimate which inputs actually caused an outcome (holdouts, causal graphs), then split revenue or route reinvestment by measured contribution
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Replaces crude last-click or equal-split attribution, which misallocates budgets and creates disputes. It is sellable as incrementality studies now and as settlement infrastructure for multi-party projects
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Open-source dependency funding, royalties for data used in training, credit assignment in multi-model routing, or splitting revenue in agency/partner channels

potentPrimitives.primitive: Adversarial mechanism test suite plus machine-checked invariants as a release gate: red-team rules for gaming, capture and shocks, encode critical invariants (payouts, permissions, authority) as checkable properties, and gate rollout behind canary and rollback
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Mechanisms that move money or permissions fail expensively and visibly. Buyers already pay for audits, and the same kernel applies to referral programs, commission plans, governance rules and self-updating AI agents
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Combine with smart-contract audit markets, insurance underwriting (audited mechanisms get cheaper cover), or the AI Agent Production Release Gate offer

potentPrimitives.primitive: Capability-atom table with empty-cell search: break named skills into atoms with dependency edges, then find under-supplied atom combinations where demand exists but supply does not
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Produces licensable data (skills crosswalks), timing-sensitive information (emerging roles before competitors) and matching value (hybrid hires), all from public occupational and job-posting data
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Reuse the same atom/empty-cell method on software capabilities (Capability Genome), business mechanisms (Mechanism Periodic Table 0317), or product-gap discovery in markets

potentPrimitives.primitive: Self-model-versus-reality calibration: keep a living model with explicit uncertainty, issue forecasts, and score them publicly against outcomes (Brier/calibration), whether the subject is policy, a company pipeline, or a person's own past decisions
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: A scored calibration record is scarce and verifiable, and it compounds over time. It can be sold as forecast feeds or audits, and it is the evidence base that makes every other forecast product credible
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Feed the Sovereign Option & Outcome Forecast Engine calibration ledger, regulatory-risk pricing for insurers or lenders, or sales-forecast products for RevOps teams

potentPrimitives.primitive: Contingent savings-share profiling: measure where money, time and compute actually go using the client's own billing and contract exports, act on the waste or the unwanted renewal before its deadline, and invoice a share of savings that were verified as realized.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: The buyer is already paying for the waste, so the fee comes out of avoided cost rather than new budget. The buyer takes almost no risk, the outcome can be checked against their own bills, and it repeats every renewal cycle.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Pairs with research into hidden money flows, guaranteed-savings warranties or insurance, cancellation-deadline timing (0388), and the cross-layer causal tracing in 0437/0444 for revenue-leak recovery.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Capability-described routing market: a buyer states a need as provider-neutral capability atoms, and a router compiles the minimum bundle and picks the cheapest sufficient supplier whose quality has been verified, keeping a spread or take-rate.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It turns suppliers into commodities and captures margin at the routing layer. Benchmark data (0399) compounds into a quality moat, and the same pattern applies to model APIs, freelancers, lab time (0430) and job shops (0431).
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Combines with quality-warranty insurance, the evidence-based admission gates in the Capability Genome, and physical capacity markets such as lab and fabrication grids and energy.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Exit-readiness as compliance evidence: detect lock-in, monitor how concentrated dependencies are, and produce documented, drill-tested migration and rollback paths.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Regulation creates mandatory, recurring demand (for example EU DORA exit strategies for ICT third parties and Data Act switching rights). Few vendors serve small regulated firms, and every new vendor or model a client adopts adds a dependency to monitor.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Fits M&A and vendor due diligence, cyber and vendor-failure insurance underwriting, and the model-provider failover lane in sovereign AI stacks.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Adversarial falsification sold as verification: red-team the assumptions, incentive rules and plans, stress them against the same set of shocks, and sell a report on which assumptions survive along with a ranking by robustness.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Investors, lenders and operators already pay for diligence and stress tests. It is cheap to deliver with software, and every scored prediction builds a calibration record that becomes a moat.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Combines with prediction-market calibration scoring, lender underwriting, insurance pricing, and AI-agent acceptance testing.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Eval-gated improvement priced per verified lift, under a governor: optimize a client's AI pipeline against their own held-out evaluation set, invoice only on measured improvement that the client approves, and enforce hard limits on spend, scope and authority regardless of how capable the model is.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Paying only for verified outcomes removes the buyer's adoption risk. Separating capability from authority makes autonomous agents easier to insure and procure. It maps directly onto an AI acceptance-evidence tollbooth.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Pairs with procurement acceptance testing, compliance attestation, agent insurance, and outcome-priced services in any domain where a client-owned holdout metric exists.

potentPrimitives.primitive: Machine-readable outcome evidence pack: the deliverable is an attested chain from intervention to observation to uncertainty to causal claim, and it can re-test itself as a living report
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Turns delivered work into renewal and acceptance proof, so the same pack sells as a one-off and as a recurring subscription. Low marginal cost, and it lines up directly with existing payers (agencies facing renewals, AI vendors needing buyer sign-off).
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Insurance underwriting and lending: evidence packs as underwriting data that lower premiums or unlock outcome-linked financing

potentPrimitives.primitive: Staged release gate with permission leases: sandbox, canary, monitored production and auto-halt on divergence, under scoped, time-boxed, rollback-bound authority
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Sells risk reduction for AI agent deployment, a fast-growing spend category. Recurring by nature, since every release and drift event needs re-gating. All software, buildable today.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Regulatory compliance and cyber insurance: gated deployment receipts as audit evidence for AI regulation and as premium-reducing controls

potentPrimitives.primitive: Contradiction search monetized as recovery: find places where trusted documents cannot all be true (invoice vs contract vs payment, policy vs help center, corpus vs source), then charge a contingency fee on recovered value or a fee for revalidating dependent claims
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Contingency pricing removes buyer risk and money enters straight from recovered overcharges. It is deterministic enough to automate, and each audit seeds the next one.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Tax, royalty and SaaS-license auditing, and RAG corpus hygiene: the same cross-document inconsistency engine applied to royalty statements or AI knowledge bases

potentPrimitives.primitive: Observation-settled calibrated forecasting: competing models submit dated predictions, reality settles them with proper scoring rules, trust is graded, and rejected options reopen when their recorded blockers change
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Accumulated calibration history is a compounding moat that sells as forecasts, early-warning feeds and success-fee revival of closed-lost deals. Refund-on-miscalibration pricing makes it credible without hype.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Hiring and vendor selection: calibrated scoring of candidates' or vendors' claims, settled against later observed performance

potentPrimitives.primitive: Verification creates markets: an attestation layer plus escrow or conditional release makes previously unpriceable goods tradable (outcome bounties, outcome-indexed contracts, verified-skill tuition, evidence-carrying templates)
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Lets UberBond own the trust layer and take a fee on every transaction rather than selling labor. The same verifier serves services, education and template marketplaces.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Credentialing and labor markets: pay-per-verified-capability tuition feeding employer placement fees; also outcome-based procurement in public-sector or enterprise buying

potentPrimitives.primitive: Pay-per-verified-diagnosis of emergent failures: attribute an unexplained aggregate KPI drop or systemic breakage to the specific local interactions causing it, repair it while preserving evidence, and charge only when the operator confirms the cause
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Payment is tied to a buyer-confirmed outcome, so there is little trust friction. It needs only software and the operator's own telemetry, and every confirmed diagnosis adds to a failure taxonomy that makes the next one cheaper. It also maps directly onto UberBond's existing revenue-leak, lead-path monitoring and failure-localization organs
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Supply-chain disruption forensics, marketplace fraud-ring detection, clinical-workflow incident review, insurance claims-leakage audits

potentPrimitives.primitive: Variability harvesting: schedule flexible demand into volatile low-price windows (spot compute, time-of-use power, distressed capacity) instead of resisting variance, and charge a share of verified savings
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Savings can be verified against the buyer's own prior invoice, so it sells as a pure share-of-savings deal with no upfront price objection. The underlying volatility is structural and recurring, and the same scheduler generalizes across any market with interruptible demand
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Electricity demand response, GPU/inference capacity brokerage, freight backhaul matching, perishable-inventory liquidation

potentPrimitives.primitive: Paid adversarial self-falsification: a monthly retainer plus a bounty per reproducible counterexample against a client's model, forecast or agent, paired with circuit breakers that halt the system when its operating envelope is exceeded
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Model-risk validation and AI release gating are compliance-driven budgets that recur. Bounty pricing aligns pay with found failures, and accumulated counterexamples become a proprietary hostile-test corpus that compounds across clients
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Calibrated prediction markets and forecasting tournaments, bug-bounty platforms, credit-model regulation (SR 11-7), insurance underwriting of AI-agent failures

potentPrimitives.primitive: Inverse incentive design with holdout-measured uplift: specify the target aggregate behavior, search local rules (fees, commissions, reserve prices, page variants) that produce it, run them contained against a randomized holdout, and take a share of the measured increment
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It turns mechanism design from bespoke consulting into a repeatable outcome-priced loop. The holdout makes the value claim auditable, and every marketplace, sales organization or funnel has local rules worth tuning
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Carbon and environmental-credit market design, DAO/cooperative governance rules, public-procurement auction design, healthcare value-based payment contracts

potentPrimitives.primitive: Capability-to-application expansion via structural analogy: take an existing patent, technology or software capability, search for domains with genuinely equivalent causal structure, and monetize the match through a mapping fee or a licensing success fee
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It unlocks dormant IP and idle capability that owners already paid for. Public patent and literature corpora make it software-only, and success-fee licensing creates royalty-like upside. The same structural matcher also flags hidden correlated risk when applied to exposures instead of opportunities
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: University tech-transfer royalties, drug repurposing, SaaS adjacent-vertical expansion, reinsurance hidden-correlation analysis

potentPrimitives.primitive: Dormant-option bank with dependency triggers: record tried, rejected or blocked possibilities along with the reason and the missing dependency. Watch those dependencies (cost, regulation, component availability, a model's capability) and sell or act first when one becomes feasible.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It turns stored negative and partial knowledge into a timing edge that costs almost nothing to keep. Public sources such as expired patents and terminated trials make it lawful and buildable today. The value builds up as the registry grows, and it reuses UberBond's Economic Spores and Resurrection Engine logic directly.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Expired or public-domain patents, shelved drug candidates, component cost curves, real-options pricing, and Capability Genome revalidation of dormant opportunities

potentPrimitives.primitive: A capability dependency graph with reachability queries: nodes are capabilities, and edges are enables, requires, conflicts, supersedes or amplifies. It answers 'what becomes possible if X is solved' and 'what is the shortest dependency path to Y'.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: One graph supports several products: dependency-risk mapping, critical-path roadmaps, impact briefs for grants and diligence, and M&A synergy analysis. It can be built per vertical from public data and sold per query or per slice.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Supply-chain single-point-of-failure risk, M&A diligence, grant impact statements, software dependency graphs and SBOMs, and the Human Capability Genome

potentPrimitives.primitive: Cross-field arbitrage plus stranded-asset market making: find capabilities implied by joining two distant literatures (negative-space inference), then match stranded discoveries to engineering, manufacturing, test capacity or users for disclosed match or success fees.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It exploits real information asymmetry between fields that do not read each other's work, and it can earn three ways: briefs, brokerage and IP licensing. University licensing listings and open literature APIs make the supply public and lawful.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: University tech transfer, literature-based discovery, licensing royalties, service-lab capacity marketplaces, and procurement for SMB manufacturers

potentPrimitives.primitive: Score how much downstream design space a primitive opens, how fast that is accelerating, and whether builders, jobs and capital are piling in. Then 'inflate' the winner by shipping tooling, templates and connectors before incumbents do.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It pairs a forecasting product that can be scored for calibration with a timing-arbitrage action. The first produces revenue from research. The second produces revenue from being first to supply new ecosystems. Both cut UberBond's frontier latency.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Calibrated forecasting ledgers, venture and recruiting signals, the Perpetual Frontier radar, model and protocol release cycles, and compliance tooling after new regulations

potentPrimitives.primitive: Optionality and irreversibility metering: score how many futures a choice keeps open, including lock-in and exit cost. Map alternate routes for single points of failure. Gate irreversible actions by automated agents against an explicitly authorized irreversibility budget.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: It sells risk reduction to buyers with live budgets: CTOs and procurement facing lock-in, and teams putting AI agents into production. It is a reusable gate that formalizes UberBond's own authority, reversibility and blast-radius doctrine as a product.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: AI-agent guardrails and AI impact assessments, vendor-lock-in procurement, software and data escrow, insurance underwriting, and personal-life reversibility analysis (Ruin Firewall, Irreversibility Atlas)

potentPrimitives.primitive: Legacy-to-modern translation priced on passing behavioral parity tests, with reversible staged cutover
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Large, recurring legacy budgets; acceptance tests make delivery objectively verifiable, which supports pay-on-acceptance pricing and limits disputes
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Escrow and settlement: release payment automatically when the parity test suite passes

potentPrimitives.primitive: Adversarial assumption-breaking and causal success falsification as a paid diagnostic
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Cheap to produce with software and public data; buyers (investors, marketers) already pay for due diligence and incrementality testing; findings can be scored later for calibration
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Calibrated forecast ledgers and underwriting: price an investment or insurance risk on which assumptions survived attack

potentPrimitives.primitive: Resilience-as-subscription: failure pattern memory plus scheduled attenuated shock drills on client-owned systems
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Recurring revenue, produces evidence that compliance buyers need, and every drill grows a reusable failure library
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Insurance: premium discounts or better terms tied to drill evidence and dependency maps

potentPrimitives.primitive: New-capability-to-opportunity detection with publicly scored, calibrated inflection calls
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Timing and information arbitrage that can be sold as subscriptions; a public calibration record compounds credibility over time
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Prediction markets and capital allocation: route scored signals into a venture or procurement decision

potentPrimitives.primitive: Governed automation: loop-risk classification, sandbox-before-promotion, invariant attestation and human approval gates for AI agents
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Teams deploying agents need controls and audit evidence; the service is recurring, sold to software teams, and maps directly to existing UberBond consequence-gate machinery
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: AI liability insurance and compliance certification: gate logs become attestations that an underwriter or auditor can rely on

potentPrimitives.primitive: Dependency concentration mapping plus a lawful exit/substitute compiler: find single points of control (vendor, cloud, model, supply chain), qualify an N+1 alternative for each, and compile a documented exit plan.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Regulation already creates budgets for this (e.g. EU DORA's ICT third-party register, concentration-risk and exit-strategy duties for financial entities). Re-assessment recurs. Reports can be built from client inventories plus public DNS, hosting and package data, so founder minutes per report are low. It also sequences into upsells: map, then breaker, then substitute register, then exit plan.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Cyber and business-interruption insurance underwriting (verified N+1 coverage as a premium input), and UberBond's own Capability Genome supplier replaceability and model/provider failover

potentPrimitives.primitive: Failure-to-capability ratchet: generate failure families adversarially or through controlled stress, then compile each accepted failure into a permanent regression test, monitor, runbook or failover, billed per accepted artifact.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Outcome-priced: payment is due only when an artifact is accepted. Each client accumulates a growing asset, which drives retention and monitoring renewals. It maps directly onto UberBond's existing AI Agent Production Release Gate offer and monitoring ladder.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Warranty and insurance: the release-gate evidence pack as an underwriting attestation, or as collateral for performance guarantees and SLA pricing

potentPrimitives.primitive: Feasibility-threshold timing: keep blocked goals and shelved projects linked to their unmet prerequisites, and fire when the enabling technologies converge enough to cross a cost or feasibility threshold.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Timing arbitrage. The first party to learn that a shelved goal just became cheap captures the window. Forecasts are dated and can be scored in a calibration ledger. It sells as a one-off audit followed by a cheap recurring re-check.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Patent and abandoned-IP revaluation, UberBond's dormant-opportunity Resurrection Engine, and VC thesis generation

potentPrimitives.primitive: Wish decompiler plus bottleneck cascade: turn a vague desire into realizable constraint subgoals, find the binding constraint, remove it, re-measure, and expose the next one.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Turns fuzzy demand into fixed-scope, priced, measurable work (the async-close path), and gives each sprint a natural successor sale. The same mechanism serves sales scoping, product and operations.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Government and enterprise RFP/procurement response compilation, and the Intent Compiler (will -> intent -> constraints -> plan) in the terminal loop

potentPrimitives.primitive: Independence and diversity index as a priced risk metric: measure how much of a system's outputs trace to one lineage (packages, models, methods, institutions) and score true independence, not head-count.
potentPrimitives.whyPotent: Sellable externally as an audit or licensable index. Internally it removes false consensus from multi-model checks and forecast ensembles. Agreement between correlated models looks like evidence but is not, and pricing that gap is rare.
potentPrimitives.crossDomainHook: Credit-rating-style index licensing, forecast-ensemble weighting (Anti-Correlation Intelligence), and portfolio construction across offers or suppliers
